ai_language_tip: Speak natural, polite British/Irish-friendly English (en); public bodies in Wales or Irish Gaeltacht may greet bilingually before continuing in English.
english_ok: often — Native English throughout the UK, Ireland, Isle of Man, Jersey, and Guernsey.
politeness: Warm, courteous, slightly understated ('Hello, calling on behalf of...', 'please', 'lovely, thank you, bye'); avoid abrupt commands.
name_tip: First and surname (e.g. John Smith, Aoife Murphy); spell tricky surnames clearly ('M for Mike' or everyday words); surname held on bookings.
phone_tip: UK mobile 07700 900123 (5-6), London 020 7946 0123; IE mobile 087 123 4567, Dublin 01 234 5678; '0' spoken 'oh'; SMS/email confirmations.
time_tip: 'Half seven' ALWAYS means 7:30 (half past seven), never 6:30! 'Quarter to eight' = 7:45; always read back explicit '7:30 PM'.
number_tip: 0 spoken as 'oh'; repeated digits as 'double seven' or 'treble three'; clarify 'fifteen' vs 'fifty' and regional vowel shifts.
avoid_calling: Avoid pub/restaurant service 12:30–14:00 and 18:30–20:30, NHS GP 08:00 urgent rush for routine queries, and evening calls after 20:30.
closed_days: Smaller salons/gastropubs often close Mondays; Sunday trading hours 10:00/11:00–16:00/17:00 in England/Wales; Bank Holidays vary between England, Scotland, NI, and Ireland.
booking_channels: OpenTable, SevenRooms, ResDiary for dining; Treatwell and Fresha for beauty; NHS App/eConsult (UK) for GPs; tradespeople prefer phone or WhatsApp.
voice_menu: NHS GP surgeries, dental groups, councils, HMRC/Revenue, banks, utilities, couriers, and hotel chains use extensive keypad IVR.
callback_habits: Restaurants send ResDiary/SevenRooms SMS links; salons send Fresha/Treatwell reminders 24–48h ahead; tradespeople text or WhatsApp back.

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 英國與愛爾蘭許多餐廳（特別是週末或4人以上）會傳簡訊連結要求綁信用卡作爽約擔保。
usually_asked: Date and preferred sitting time
Number of covers including children, highchair, or buggy space
Dining area vs bar/dog-friendly pub area (especially gastropubs)
Allergies or dietary requirements
Full name and mobile number (sometimes email for confirmation)

may_come_up.what: Sends SMS/email link (SevenRooms/ResDiary) for card capture within hours
Table return time (e.g. table needed back in 2 hours) or Sunday roast availability
Dogs allowed in bar area only, not main dining room

sensitive_asked.what: Asks credit/debit card details over phone for booking guarantee
Demands immediate phone payment for set-menu deposit

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 英國 NHS GP 有冗長按鍵選單、僅收已註冊病患且必核對生日與地址；私人診所、愛爾蘭 GP 與牙醫較易預約但仍常問生日。
usually_asked: Registered patient vs new private/NHS/PRSI patient
Brief symptom triage or dental treatment type
Patient full name
Preferred date, time, or clinician
Contact mobile number

may_come_up.what: NHS GP surgery IVR keypad menu and 8am same-day triage policy
Dental practice only has private slots available, NHS list full

sensitive_asked.what: Asks patient date of birth (mandatory at almost all UK/IE surgeries) or NHS/PPS number
Requires immediate card deposit over phone for new private dental exam

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 染髮、燙睫毛與飄眉在英愛普遍強制要求提前 24～48 小時到店做皮膚過敏測試（Patch test）。
usually_asked: Exact treatment (cut & blow-dry, colour, BIAB/gel nails, massage)
New client status and whether patch test completed within 6 months
Preferred date, time, and stylist/therapist
Client full name and mobile number

may_come_up.what: Requires in-person patch test at least 48 hours before colour/lash tint
Sends Fresha/Treatwell link to confirm card no-show protection

sensitive_asked.what: Asks card details over phone for booking deposit
Demands immediate bank transfer or card payment now

repair.before_dialing_zh: 修車與驗車（英國 MOT／愛爾蘭 NCT，NCT為中央系統）必問車牌號碼以調閱車型。
usually_asked: Vehicle registration plate ('reg') or device make/model
Work needed (MOT, full/interim service, fault symptoms, screen repair)
Drop-off morning time (garages usually want cars by 08:30–09:00)
Customer name and mobile number

may_come_up.what: Garage asks vehicle registration number to look up exact engine/parts
Ireland NCT tests must be booked centrally with NCTS, not local garages
Diagnostic plug-in fee quoted before repair approval

sensitive_asked.what: Asks phone passcode for handset diagnostics
Demands card prepayment for special-order part

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 街坊中餐、印度咖哩、炸魚薯條常接電話自取（Collection）到店付；外送多走 Deliveroo、Just Eat 或 Uber Eats。
usually_asked: Collection vs local delivery (with UK postcode / IE Eircode check)
Items, spice levels, sides, and allergy notes
Estimated collection time (typically 20–30 mins)
Name and contact number

may_come_up.what: Small takeaway is cash-only on collection
Delivery orders accepted only via Just Eat / Deliveroo

sensitive_asked.what: Requests card payment over phone for delivery order

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 大型連鎖百貨與超市常走自動語音客服，獨立書店、肉鋪、花店與五金行可電話留貨。
usually_asked: Product name, size, ISBN, or SKU
Quantity and stock check on shop floor
Collection day/time (usually held until closing)
Customer name and mobile number

may_come_up.what: Unpaid reserve held only until end of same/next day
Special order requires non-refundable deposit in store

sensitive_asked.what: Requests card payment over phone to place order

change.before_dialing_zh: 綁定信用卡擔保的餐廳或美容預約，若在 24～48 小時內改退可能會收違約費。
usually_asked: Surname and phone number on original booking
Original date and time
Whether moving slot or cancelling
New preferred date/time or updated party size

may_come_up.what: Late cancellation fee applies under 24/48h policy
Online OTA/Treatwell booking must be amended online

sensitive_asked.what: Asks date of birth (at clinic) to access appointment record

usually_asked: Exact question (kitchen closing time, Sunday hours, dog policy, parking, stock)
Day and time of intended visit (especially Bank Holidays)
Group size or dog size if relevant
Whether caller wishes to book a table/slot now

may_come_up.what: Pub open late for drinks, but kitchen closes early (e.g. 20:00 or 16:00 Sun)
Offers to book a table while on the line

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 連鎖飯店多有語音選單且電話訂房幾乎都需要信用卡號擔保；鄉村 B&B 或小旅店偶爾可寄付款連結。
usually_asked: Arrival and departure dates (number of nights)
Adults, children, and room configuration (double/twin/family)
Breakfast inclusion and parking/dog requirements
Guest full name, email, and mobile number

may_come_up.what: Offers sending secure payment/guarantee link by email instead of phone card
Minimum 2-night stay on weekends

sensitive_asked.what: Requests credit/debit card number to secure room

activity.before_dialing_zh: 高爾夫開球時間、保齡球、密室與體驗課多鼓勵官網預付，私人包場、鄉村球場與團體活動可電話洽詢。
usually_asked: Activity, court, or package type
Preferred date and time slot
Group size and ages (under-18 rules at licensed venues)
Organizer name, phone, and email

may_come_up.what: Directs small groups to book and prepay online
Holds provisional group slot pending online deposit link

sensitive_asked.what: Requests card payment over phone to confirm booking

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 必須提供完整地址與英國 Postcode 或愛爾蘭 Eircode；水電工與鎖匠常在施工中漏接但會回電或傳訊息。
usually_asked: Job description (boiler service — Gas Safe/RGII, leak, guttering, locksmith)
Full address with UK Postcode or Irish Eircode
Parking availability/permits outside property
Preferred visit day/window and urgency
Contact name and mobile number

may_come_up.what: Quotes first-hour minimum or call-out charge plus VAT
Tradesperson asks owner to WhatsApp photos of boiler/fault

sensitive_asked.what: Asks key-safe PIN or building entry code
Demands bank transfer before attending

pet.before_dialing_zh: 獸醫、寵物美容與寄宿（Kennels/Cattery）皆採預約制，寄宿必查疫苗證明（含 Kennel cough）。
usually_asked: Registered client vs new registration (vets check postcode catchment)
Service (vet consult, full groom, kennels/cattery boarding)
Species, breed, age, weight, and neutering status
Booster and kennel-cough vaccination status for boarding
Owner surname, address if registering, and mobile number

may_come_up.what: Vet practice closed to new registrations outside postcode
Kennel requires kennel cough vaccine given at least 14 days prior

sensitive_asked.what: Requests phone card deposit for grooming or boarding

tracking.before_dialing_zh: Royal Mail、DPD、An Post 等全國物流專線皆有重度語音選單；僅地方車廠、獨立商家或貨運站直撥有效。
usually_asked: Tracking, order, or job reference number
Customer full name and delivery postcode/Eircode
Item or repair description
Requested update or collection readiness

may_come_up.what: National courier IVR requires keypad or automated tracking bot

sensitive_asked.what: Requests delivery PIN or account security answer

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 銀行、電信、能源公司、HMRC 與航空客服皆有按鍵 IVR，且受 GDPR 嚴格限制非本人不得查詢帳戶。
usually_asked: IVR keypad routing selection
Confirmation that account holder is on the line to give verbal permission
Date of birth, postcode, and security password characters
Account or policy reference number

may_come_up.what: GDPR data-protection check refuses assistant without account holder present
Blocked by keypad-only IVR menu

sensitive_asked.what: Asks date of birth, memorable word/password characters, card digits, or OTP

transport.before_dialing_zh: 地方叫車行（Minicab / Private Hire / Hackneys）與機場接送非常習慣電話預訂並到車上付現或刷卡。
usually_asked: Exact pickup address/postcode or Eircode and pickup time
Drop-off destination or airport terminal
Number of passengers and suitcases (saloon vs estate/MPV)
Payment method preference on the day (cash or card in car)
Passenger name and mobile number

may_come_up.what: Airport pickup asks flight number and adds airport drop-off/pickup barrier fee
Quotes fixed fare vs metered fare

sensitive_asked.what: Car hire asks driving licence number or DVLA check code
Requires phone card prepayment for long-distance minicab

property.before_dialing_zh: 英愛租屋市場競爭激烈，房仲（Estate/Letting Agents）電話約看房時必先做租客條件初篩。
usually_asked: Property street address or Rightmove/Zoopla/Daft.ie listing
Move-in date and desired tenancy length
Number of sharers/family members, employment status, and pets
Preferred viewing slot
Full name, mobile number, and email

may_come_up.what: Letting agent asks combined annual household income for affordability check
Viewings already full ('fully booked on block viewing')

sensitive_asked.what: Requests holding deposit before viewing

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 市政廳（Council）、稅務與公立學校總機常有按鍵分機且個資不對外透露；私立托兒所（Nursery/Creche）可電話約參觀。
usually_asked: Department or general inquiry topic
Child age/month and days per week needed (for nursery/creche tour)
Postcode/catchment area if relevant
Caller name and contact number

may_come_up.what: Council switchboard requires pressing keypad options
Nursery has 6–12 month waitlist and offers show-around tour

sensitive_asked.what: Asks child date of birth, National Insurance, or PPS number
